#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>

class HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching {
public:
    const int m, n;
    const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& g;
    std::vector<int> pairU, pairV, dis;
    const int inf = 10000000;
    const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching(int m, int n, const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& g)
        : m(m), n(n), g(g), pairU(m + 1, NIL), pairV(n + 1, NIL), dis(m + 1) {}

    int maximumMatching() {
        std::fill(pairU.begin(), pairU.end(), NIL);
        std::fill(pairV.begin(), pairV.end(), NIL);
        int maxMatching = 0;

        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                if (pairU[i] == NIL && dfs(i)) {
                    maxMatching++;
                }
            }
        }
        return maxMatching;
    }

    bool bfs() {
        std::queue<int> q;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            if (pairU[i] == NIL) {
                q.push(i);
                dis[i] = 0;
            } else {
                dis[i] = inf;
            }
        }
        dis[NIL] = inf;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == inf) {
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                        dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[NIL] < inf;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u != NIL) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 2) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            dis[u] = inf;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

class InputReader {
private:
    std::istream& stream;
    char buf[1024];
    int curChar, numChars;

public:
    InputReader(std::istream& stream) : stream(stream), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

private:
    bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class OutputWriter {
private:
    std::ostream& writer;

public:
    OutputWriter(std::ostream& outputStream) : writer(outputStream) {}

    void println(long long i) {
        writer << i << "\n";
    }
};

class Solver {
public:
    int n, m;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        long long ans = 0;

        if (n > 100) {
            int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
            long long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
            ans += nq * 6LL * m;
            n = 100 + nn;
        }

        if (m > 100) {
            int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
            long long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
            ans += mq * 6LL * n;
            m = 100 + nm;
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> mat(n + 1, std::vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
        int u = 1, v = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) mat[i][j] = u++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) mat[i][j] = v++;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> adj(u);
        for (int i = 0; i < u; i++) adj[i] = std::vector<int>();

        int di[12] = {-3, -2, -2, 0, -1, 1, 0, -1, 1, 3, 2, 2};
        int dj[12] = {0, -1, 1, -3, -2, -2, 3, 2, 2, 0, -1, 1};

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                        int ni = i + di[k], nj = j + dj[k];
                        if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= m) {
                            adj[mat[i][j]].push_back(mat[ni][nj]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching bpm(u - 1, v - 1, adj);
        ans += 2LL * bpm.maximumMatching();
        out.println(ans);
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    OutputWriter out(std::cout);
    Solver solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
